paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish (a Tanna), Shabbat 43b.
R' Shimon ben Lakish, the well-known one.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The notice distinguishes the Tanna Yehudah ben Lakish from the “well-known” Shimon ben Lakish.

The actual Davidson Shabbat 43b paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish. The separate well-known Shimon pointer remains R' in the new body because that occurrence was not freshly collated. The existing note remains verbatim. These are distinct lexical pointers, without a shared-father inference or an identity merge.
